subtitle_en: Hold the bell-tower road and gather chronicle remnants.
Leave the pass ready for whoever comes next.
Read the wet record honestly and find its owner.
Bring a dish, say a name, and keep a seat for everyone.
Three cases, four approaches: learn what the first move protects.
Carry the medicine down the salt road and tell the truth about it.
Teach the relief stop to run without you.
Witness the eclipse from the ridge and the terrace, and keep what you saw.
